name: Adithya R B
tagline: Aspiring Software Developer | Computer Engineering Student | Exploring Ideas Through Code
bio: I am a developer interested in Java programming, game development, and building interactive applications. I contributed in developing Era Escape, a Java Swing-based escape room game featuring multiple levels, puzzles, hints, timers, and a global lives system. I enjoy learning new technologies and turning creative ideas into working projects.

projects.title: Era Escape
projects.desc: A Java Swing-based escape room puzzle game featuring multiple levels, challenging puzzles, hints, timers, and a global 3-life system with life regeneration. Level 7 takes players into Ancient Greece to solve the mysteries of the Lost Temple.
